inputs.name: n8n_version
inputs.description: Tag of the n8n image, such as "2.45.6". Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for n8n_version, such as "sha256:45ed...". Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: image_repository
inputs.description: Where to pull n8n's image from. "ghcr.io/n8n-io/n8n" serves the same image, by the same digest, without Docker Hub's pull limits.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address n8n listens on. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: public_url
inputs.description: The address people and webhook callers reach n8n at, such as "https://n8n.example.com". It sets N8N_HOST, N8N_PROTOCOL, WEBHOOK_URL and N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL, and an https address turns on secure cookies. When null, n8n builds its URLs from listen_address and port.

inputs.name: proxy_hops
inputs.description: How many reverse proxies stand in front of n8n. n8n trusts that many X-Forwarded-For entries for the client's address. Set 0 when people reach n8n directly.

inputs.name: postgres
inputs.type:
object({
    host     = optional(string, "127.0.0.1")
    port     = optional(number, 5432)
    database = optional(string, "n8n")
    username = optional(string, "n8n")
    schema   = optional(string, "public")
  })
inputs.description: PostgreSQL to keep n8n's data in, such as { host = "db1" }. The role and database must exist. When null, n8n uses SQLite in /var/lib/n8n.

inputs.name: postgres_password
inputs.description: Password of the postgres username. Needed with postgres. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_postgres_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.description: The owner account to create on the first start, such as { email = "you@example.com" }. When null, n8n asks for one the first time you open it.

inputs.name: owner_password
inputs.description: Password the owner is created with. Needed with owner. n8n wants 8 to 64 characters with a digit and an uppercase letter. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_owner_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: executions_prune
inputs.description: Delete old execution data, so the database doesn't grow without end. Sets EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE.

inputs.name: executions_max_age
inputs.description: Hours to keep finished executions for before pruning deletes them. Sets EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE. The default is two weeks, as in n8n.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: More of n8n's environment variables, such as { GENERIC_TIMEZONE = "Europe/London", N8N_SMTP_PASS = "..." }. They go in a root-only env file and never reach the plan or state.
